name: Futuramo (legacy suite)
description_en:
The Futuramo task-management candidate refers to its legacy business suite, including Tasks, Visual Tickets and Time Tracker. The current official privacy policy says those applications are being retired. Meanwhile, the homepage and About page now describe Futuramo Apps as software discovery with a personal Library. They are different product scopes under the same domain.

This profile is therefore an existing-user and historical-scope reference, not a recommendation to start a new team task workspace. It explains what can be supported by current official material, what belongs to an older brochure, and what an existing customer still needs to confirm about access and data. No legacy account or export was accessed.
description_zh:
此次任务管理候选对应 Futuramo 的旧业务套件，包括 Tasks、Visual Tickets 和 Time Tracker。当前官方隐私政策称这些应用正在退役；首页及 About 页则已将 Futuramo Apps 描述为带个人 Library 的软件发现平台。同一域名下存在不同产品范围。

因此，本档案作为已有用户及历史范围参考，不推荐据此新建团队任务工作区。以下区分当前官方资料能支持的结论、旧宣传册内容，以及已有客户仍需确认的访问与数据条件。本次未访问旧账户或导出。

sections.title_en: Confirm whether you mean the suite or the new Library
sections.title_zh: 先确认指旧套件还是新 Library
sections.en:
The current About page describes a curated software catalog with saved tools, statuses, collections, tags, ratings and notes. Those statuses track software evaluation and subscription decisions. They should not be presented as a continuation of a project task’s execution workflow.

The current privacy policy explicitly calls Futuramo Suite legacy business applications being retired. That is stronger evidence of a transition than the old task-management label in a directory. It does not give a single final shutdown date or prove the state of a particular customer account. Keep account-specific access, renewal and exit instructions separate from the new Apps registration flow.
sections.zh:
当前 About 页描述精选软件目录，以及保存工具、状态、集合、标签、评分和备注。这些状态跟踪软件评估与订阅决策，不应写成原项目任务执行流程的延续。

当前隐私政策明确称 Futuramo Suite 为正在退役的旧业务应用，比目录里的旧任务管理标签更能证明转型。但它没有提供统一最终关闭日期，也不能证明某个客户账户的状态。应把账户访问、续期及退出说明与新 Apps 注册流程分开。

sections.title_en: What the older suite description actually covered
sections.title_zh: 旧套件介绍实际覆盖什么
sections.en:
A cached official one-page brochure describes Tasks as task creation/assignment with descriptions, checklists, attachments and comments. Visual Tickets used images/screenshots for requests, while Time Tracker recorded activity time. These were related applications, not evidence that every Tasks license included every other application. The brochure marked Tasks Gantt, Kanban and task groups coming soon.

Its later screenshot retrieval returned404, so the cached text is historical context only. Do not convert those forthcoming labels into present features. An existing user should inspect the actual licensed apps and records before choosing a migration scope. No current UI, view availability or report accuracy was verified.
sections.zh:
缓存的官方单页宣传册将 Tasks 描述为支持任务创建／分派、说明、清单、附件及评论；Visual Tickets 用图片／截图表达请求，Time Tracker 记录活动时间。这些是相关应用，不证明每份 Tasks 许可都包括其他应用。册中还把 Tasks 的 Gantt、Kanban 和任务分组标为即将推出。

之后截图获取返回 404，因此缓存正文只作为历史上下文。不能把即将推出标签改写为现有功能。已有用户选择迁移范围前，应检查实际获许可应用及记录。本次未验证当前界面、视图可用性或报告准确性。

sections.title_en: Inventory the work before choosing an exit method
sections.title_zh: 选择退出方式前先盘点工作
sections.en:
For an existing team, a useful evaluation sample is one known client/project with a task, comment, attached file and any associated ticket or time entry. Identify which app owns each item and whether the actual export includes file bytes, history, dates, memberships and relationships. This is a proposed inventory, not a verified export recipe.

The current privacy notice refers legacy processing to its applicable service information and contracts. It does not establish a new Suite backup format, export deadline, retention period or restoration promise. Request the customer-specific retirement instructions and retain an independent usable copy before removing access or ending payment. No task, ticket, timer, data download or migration was performed.
sections.zh:
对于已有团队，可用一个已知客户／项目及其任务、评论、附件和相关工单或工时作为评估样本，确定每项由哪个应用保存，并检查实际导出是否包含文件本体、历史、日期、成员关系及关联。这是建议盘点，不是已验证的导出步骤。

当前隐私说明把旧套件处理指向适用的服务资料及合同，没有确立新的 Suite 备份格式、导出期限、保留期或恢复承诺。移除访问或终止付款前，应取得具体客户的退役说明并保留独立可用副本。本次未操作任务、工单、计时、数据下载或迁移。

sections.title_en: The new free account is not a legacy-suite price
sections.title_zh: 新免费账户不是旧套件价格
sections.en:
The current Terms of Use define the Service as the Apps software-discovery/research platform and say its public and account features are currently free. Those terms do not establish free access, renewal rates or license extensions for the retiring business suite. The old pricing URL returned404, and a cached search result about the old login notice was not treated as current service access: the browser rendered a404 there too.

Existing customers need their applicable contract, latest invoice and retirement communication to determine remaining access and payment. No current Suite rate, trial or sustained-free entitlement is asserted. The legacy software license and source/self-host rights also remain unverified; free access to the newer directory would not establish open-source rights to the older suite.
sections.zh:
当前 Terms of Use 将服务定义为 Apps 软件发现／研究平台，并称其公开及账户功能目前免费。这些条款不能确立正在退役业务套件的免费访问、续期费率或许可延期。旧定价 URL 返回 404；旧登录提示的搜索缓存也未当作当前服务访问证据，浏览器在该入口同样显示 404。

已有客户需根据适用合同、最新账单及退役通知确定剩余访问和付款。本档案不确认当前 Suite 费率、试用或持续免费权益。旧软件许可及源码／自托管权仍未核实；新目录免费也不等于旧套件开源。

sections.title_en: Use this record for continuity checks
sections.title_zh: 用本档案检查业务连续性
sections.en:
This record can help an existing customer avoid confusing a new catalog account with access to old project records. A new team should first obtain explicit current availability and terms for the intended task product; the present retirement statement is a material condition, not a minor feature limitation.

For continuity review, compare the known sample with whatever export or support process the vendor supplies, including a missing attachment and an unavailable-login case. Confirm what remains accessible after the contract ends. No alternatives relationship is approved here, and no migration success, complete shutdown date, security certification or recovery guarantee has been established.
sections.zh:
本档案可帮助已有客户避免把新目录账户与旧项目记录访问混淆。新团队应先取得目标任务产品当前可用性及条款的明确说明；正在退役是重要采用条件，不是普通功能限制。

连续性复核应将已知样本与厂商提供的导出或支持流程比较，包括附件缺失及无法登录情形，并确认合同结束后还能访问什么。此次未批准替代关系，也未确立迁移成功、完整关闭日期、安全认证或恢复保证。
